title: Changes for Cooldown
description: Changes for Cooldown - The mod allows you to see item cooldowns on servers, and it also has an optional feature for the BloodStone server that shows the seconds remaining before the end of PvP.
body:
**Changes for Cooldown** — a convenient mod for tracking item cooldown times directly on your screen.
This mod displays the remaining cooldown time for items in a customizable HUD element that can be positioned anywhere on the screen. Full customization is supported for position, size, and appearance of the cooldown indicators.
PvP Timer: The mod includes a built-in PvP timer that shows the exact time remaining during PvP rounds. Please note that this feature works only on servers that support this functionality and may not be available on all servers.
Compatibility: Item cooldown tracking is compatible with all servers and proxy servers, ensuring universal compatibility and convenience while playing on any Minecraft servers.
